title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: Linear separability means that you can draw a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) that separates the two classes without any overlap. Consider the features hue and abv. Can a straight line separate the two wine types based on these features?

title: Standardized Features
text: Since the features are standardized, they have a mean of $$0$$ and a standard deviation of $$1$$. This means they are on the same scale. Does this affect the linear separability?

title: Logistic Regression Model
text: The logistic regression model is given by $$P(Y=1|x)=\operatorname{\sigma}\left(\theta_1 hue+\theta_2 abv\right)$$. This model assumes a linear relationship between the features and the log-odds of the outcome. Does this imply linear separability?

title: Evaluating Linear Separability
text: Given the standardized features and the logistic regression model, determine if the data is linearly separable without any feature transformations.
